31.ar: نَزَلَ جَبْرَئِیلُ (علیه السلام) عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ قُرَیْشاً قَدِ اجْتَمَعَتْ فِی دَارِ النَّدْوَةِ یُدَبِّرُونَ عَلَیْکَ وَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ فِی ذَلِکَ وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ أَوْ یُخْرِجُوکَ وَ یَمْکُرُونَ وَ یَمْکُرُ اللهُ وَ اللهُ خَیْرُ الْماکِرِینَ.
31.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- جبرئیل بر رسول خدا (نازل شد و به او خبر داد که قریش در دارالنّدوه گرد هم آمدند تا برعلیه تو توطئه بچینند و خدا این آیه را در این‌باره نازل کرد: وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُواْ لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ أَوْ یُخْرِجُوکَ وَ یَمْکُرُونَ وَ یَمْکُرُ اللهُ وَ اللهُ خَیْرُ المَاکِرِینَ.
31.en: Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and informed him that the Quraysh had gathered in Dar al-Nadwa to plot against him. Regarding this, Allah revealed to him: "And [remember, O Muhammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners."
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 5, p. 526

31.ar: أَنَّ قُرَیْشاً اجْتَمَعَتْ فَخَرَجَ مِنْ کُلِّ بَطْنٍ أُنَاسٌ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقُوا إِلَی دَارِ النَّدْوَةِ لِیُشَاوِرُوا فِیمَا یَصْنَعُونَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَإِذَا هُمْ بِشَیْخٍ قَائِمٍ عَلَی الْبَابِ وَ إِذَا ذَهَبُوا إِلَیْهِ لِیَدْخُلُوا قَالَ أَدْخِلُونِی مَعَکُمْ قَالُوا وَ مَنْ أَنْتَ یَا شَیْخُ قَالَ أَنَا شَیْخٌ مِنْ مُضَرَ وَ لِی رَأْیٌ أُشِیرُ بِهِ عَلَیْکُمْ فَدَخَلُوا وَ جَلَسُوا وَ تَشَاوَرُوا وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ وَ أَجْمَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ عَلَی أَنْ یُخْرِجُوهُ فَقَالَ لَیْسَ هَذَا لَکُمْ بِرَأْیٍ إِنْ أَخْرَجْتُمُوهُ أَجْلَبَ عَلَیْکُمُ النَّاسَ فَقَاتَلُوکُمْ قَالُوا صَدَقْتَ مَا هَذَا بِرَأْیٍ ثُمَّ تَشَاوَرُوا فَأَجْمَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ عَلَی أَنْ یُوثِقُوهُ قَالَ هَذَا لَیْسَ بِالرَّأْیِ إِنْ فَعَلْتُمْ هَذَا وَ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) رَجُلٌ حُلْوُ اللِّسَانِ أَفْسَدَ عَلَیْکُمْ أَبْنَاءَکُمْ وَ خَدَمَکُمْ وَ مَا یَنْفَعُکُمْ أَحَدُکُمْ إِذَا فَارَقَهُ أَخُوهُ وَ ابْنُهُ أَوِ امْرَأَتُهُ ثُمَّ تَشَاوَرُوا فَأَجْمَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ عَلَی أَنْ یَقْتُلُوهُ یَخْرُجُونَ مِنْ کُلِّ بَطْنٍ مِنْهُمْ بِشَاهِرٍ فَیَضْرِبُونَهُ بِأَسْیَافِهِمْ جَمِیعاً عِندَ الکَعبَة ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْآیَةَ وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ ...
31.fa: امام باقر (- گروهی از قریش از قبایل مختلف آن، جمع شده و به‌سوی دارالنّدوهًْ حرکت کردند تا درباره‌ی اینکه با رسول خدا (چه برخوردی نمایند با یکدیگر مشورت کنند. هنگام ورود به دارالنّدوه به پیرمردی برخورد کردند که جلوی درب ورودی ایستاده بود و به آن‌ها گفت: «مرا نیز همراه خود به جلسه ببرید». پرسیدند: «ای پیرمرد تو کیستی»!؟ گفت: «پیرمردی از قبیله‌ی مُضر هستم و نظری دارم که آن را در اختیار شما خواهم گذاشت». همگی داخل شده و نشستند و در حضور پیرمرد به مشورت پرداختند و به این نتیجه رسیدند که پیامبر (را از مکّه بیرون نمایند، آن پیرمرد گفت: «این فکری اساسی برای شما نیست چراکه اگر او را بیرون نمایید دیگر قبایل را بر ضدّ شما جمع کرده و با شما به جنگ خواهند پرداخت». قریش گفتند: «راست می‌گویی این نظر درستی نیست». دوباره به مشورت پرداخته و به این نتیجه رسیدند که پیامبر (را دربند کنند. پیرمرد گفت: «این هم نظر درستی نیست، اگر این کار را بکنید با توجّه به اینکه محمّد (گفتاری شیرین دارد [با کلام شیوای خود] فرزندان و خدمتکاران شما را تباه سازد و هرگاه یکی از شما برادر، فرزند یا همسرش را [به‌واسطه‌ی گرویدن به محمّد (] از دست بدهد چیزی به حالش سودمند نخواهد بود». دوباره به مشورت پرداخته و این‌بار به این نتیجه رسیدند که پیامبر (را به قتل برسانند به این صورت که از هر قبیله‌ی قریش، شمشیرزنی انتخاب شود و جملگی با شمشیرهایشان در کنار کعبه پیامبر (را بزنند». آنگاه امام (این آیه را تلاوت فرمود: وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ.
31.en: A group of the Quraysh gathered, and people from every clan went out and headed to Dar al-Nadwah to consult on what they should do with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). When they arrived, they found an old man standing at the door. When they went toward him to enter, he said, "Let me enter with you." They asked, "Who are you, old man?" He replied, "I am an old man from Mudar, and I have an opinion that I will offer you." They entered, sat down, and consulted while he sat with them. They agreed to expel him [the Prophet], but the old man said, "This is not a sound opinion for you. If you expel him, he will incite the people against you, and they will fight you." They said, "You are right; this is not a sound opinion." Then they consulted again and agreed to imprison him. He said, "This is not the right opinion either. If you do this, and Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is a man with a sweet tongue, he will corrupt your sons and servants against you, and it will be of no benefit to you if one of you loses his brother, son, or wife." Then they consulted again and agreed to kill him by having a swordsman from every clan go out and strike him with their swords all together at the Kaaba. Then he [the Imam] recited the verse: "And [remember, O Muhammad,] when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you..."
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 5, p. 526
31.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 19, p. 52; Al-Burhan (noting "bashab" instead of "bashahir" and the omission of "jami'an 'inda al-katifayn"); Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 53; and Nur al-Thaqalayn (noting "al-Kaaba" instead of "al-katifayn").

31.ar: اجْتَمَعَ الْمُشْرِکُونَ فِی دَارِ النَّدْوَةِ لِیَتَشَاوَرُوا فِی أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَتَی جَبْرَئِیلُ (علیه السلام) رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَأَخْبَرَهُ الْخَبَرَ وَ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ لَا یَنَامَ فِی مَضْجَعِهِ تِلْکَ اللَّیْلَةَ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) الْمَبِیتَ أَمَرَ عَلِیّاً (علیه السلام) أَنْ یَبِیتَ فِی مَضْجَعِهِ تِلْکَ اللَّیْلَةَ فَبَاتَ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) وَ تَغَشَّی بِبُرْدٍ أَخْضَرَ حَضْرَمِیٍّ کَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) یَنَامُ فِیهِ وَ جَعَلَ السَّیْفَ إِلَی جَنْبِهِ فَلَمَّا اجْتَمَعَ أُولَئِکَ النَّفَرُ مِنْ قُرَیْشٍ یَطِیفُونَ وَ یَرْصُدُونَهُ یُرِیدُونَ قَتْلَهُ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ هُمْ جُلُوسٌ عَلَی الْبَابِ خَمْسَةٌ وَ عِشْرُونَ رَجُلًا فَأَخَذَ حَفْنَةً مِنَ الْبَطْحَاءِ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ یَذُرُّهَا عَلَی رُءُوسِهِمْ وَ هُوَ یَقْرَأُ یس وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْحَکِیمِ حَتَّی بَلَغَ فَأَغْشَیْناهُمْ فَهُمْ لا یُبْصِرُونَ فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ مَا تَنْتَظِرُونَ قَالُوا مُحَمَّداً (صلی الله علیه و آله) قَالَ خِبْتُمْ وَ خُزِیتُمْ قَدْ وَ اللَّهِ مَرَّ بِکُمْ فَمَا مِنْکُمْ رَجُلٌ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ جَعَلَ عَلَی رَأْسِهِ تُرَاباً قَالُوا وَ اللَّهِ مَا أَبْصَرْنَاهُ قَالَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ أَوْ یُخْرِجُوکَ وَ یَمْکُرُونَ وَ یَمْکُرُ اللهُ وَ اللهُ خَیْرُ الْماکِرِینَ.
31.en: The polytheists gathered in Dar al-Nadwah to consult regarding the affair of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family). Gabriel (peace be upon him) came to the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), informed him of the news, and commanded him not to sleep in his bed that night. When the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) intended to spend the night, he ordered Ali (peace be upon him) to sleep in his bed that night. Ali (peace be upon him) slept there and covered himself with a green Hadrami cloak that belonged to the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), in which he used to sleep, and he placed a sword by his side. When those men from Quraysh gathered, circling and watching him, intending to kill him, the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) went out while they were sitting at the door—twenty-five men. He took a handful of dust from the valley floor and began to scatter it over their heads while reciting: "Ya Sin. By the Wise Quran..." until he reached: "...and We have covered them, so they do not see." Someone said, "What are you waiting for?" They replied, "Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)." He said, "You have failed and are disgraced! By God, he passed by you, and there is not one among you but that he has placed dust upon his head." They said, "By God, we did not see him!" Then God, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed: "And [remember, O Muhammad,] when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners."
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 5, p. 528
31.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 19, p. 52; Al-Amali by al-Tusi, p. 445; Al-Burhan; "Khasirtum" (you have lost) instead of "Khazaytum" (you are disgraced).

31.ar: ِعَنْ هِنْدِ بْنِ أَبِی هَالَة کَانَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِمَّا یَمْنَعُ نَبِیَّهُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِعَمِّهِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) فَمَا یَخْلُصُ إِلَیْهِ امْرُؤٌ بِسُوءٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مُدَّةَ حَیَاتِهِ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ أَبُوطَالِبٍ نَالَتْ قُرَیْشٌ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِغَیَّتِهَا وَ أَصَابَتْهُ بِعَظِیمٍ مِنَ الْأَذَی حَتَّی تَرَکَتْهُ لَقًی فَقَالَ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لَأَسْرَعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا فَقْدُکَ یَا عَمِّ وَصَلَتْکَ رَحِمٌ وَ جُزِیتَ خَیْراً یَا عَمِّ ثُمَّ مَاتَتْ خَدِیجَةُ (سلام الله علیها) بَعْدَ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) بِشَهْرٍ وَ اجْتَمَعَ بِذَلِکَ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) حُزْنَانِ حَتَّی عُرِفَ ذَلِکَ فِیهِ قَالَ هِنْدٌ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ ذَوُو الطَّوْلِ وَ الشَّرَفِ مِنْ قُرَیْشٍ إِلَی دَارِ النَّدْوَةِ لِیَرْتَئُوا وَ یَأْتَمِرُوا فِی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَسَرُّوا ذَلِکَ بَیْنَهُمْ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ نَبْنِی لَهُ عَلَماً وَ نَتْرُکُ فُرَجاً نَسْتَوْدِعُهُ فِیهِ فَلَا یَخْلُصُ مِنَ الصُّبَاةِ فِیهِ إِلَیْهِ أَحَدٌ وَ لَا نَزَالُ فِی رَفَقٍ مِنَ الْعَیْشِ حَتَّی یَتَضَیَّفَهُ رَیْبُ الْمَنُونِ وَ صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الْمَشُورَةِ الْعَاصُ بْنُ وَائِلٍ وَ أُمَیَّةُ وَ أُبَیٌّ ابْنَا خَلَفٍ فَقَالَ قَائِلٌ کَلَّا مَا هَذَا لَکُمْ بِرَأْیٍ وَ لَئِنْ صَنَعْتُمْ ذَلِکَ لَیَتَنَمَّرَنَّ لَهُ الْحَدِبُ الْحَمِیمُ وَ الْمَوْلَی الْحَلِیفُ ثُمَّ لَیَأْتِیَنَّ الْمَوَاسِمَ وَ الْأَشْهُرَ الْحُرُمَ بِالْأَمْنِ فَلَیَنْتَزِعَنَّ مِنْ أُنْشُوطَتِکُمْ قُولُوا قَوْلَکُمْ. فَقَالَ عُتْبَةُ وَ شَیْبَةُ وَ شَ-رِکَهُمَا أَبُوسُفْ-یَانَ قَالُوا فَإِنَّا نَرَی أَنْ نُرْحِ-لَ بَعِیراً صَعْباً وَ نُوثِقَ مُحَمَّداً (صلی الله علیه و آله) عَلَیْهِ کِتَافاً ثُمَّ نَقْطَعَ الْبَعِیرَ بِأَطْرَافِ الرِّمَاحِ فَیُوشِکُ أَنْ یَقْطَعَهُ بَیْنَ الدَّکَادِکِ إِرْباً إِرْباً فَقَالَ صَاحِبُ رَأْیِهِمْ إِنَّکُمْ لَمْ تَصْنَعُوا بِقَوْلِکُمْ هَذَا شَیْئاً أَ رَأَیْتُمْ إِنْ خَلَصَ بِهِ الْبَعِیرُ سَالِماً إِلَی بَعْضِ الْأَفَارِیقِ فَأَخَذَ بِقُلُوبِهِمْ بِسِحْرِهِ وَ بَیَانِهِ وَ طَلَاقَةِ لِسَانِهِ فَصَبَأَ الْقَوْمُ إِلَیْهِ وَ اسْتَجَابَتِ الْقَبَائِلُ لَهُ قَبِیلَةً فَقَبِیلَةً فَلَیَسِیرَنَّ حِینَئِذٍ إِلَیْکُمْ بِالْکَتَائِبِ وَ الْمَقَانِبِ فَلَتَهْلِکُنَّ کَمَا هَلَکَتْ أَیَادٌ وَ مَنْ کَانَ قَبْلَکُمْ. قُولُوا قَوْلَکُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُوجَهْلٍ لَکِنْ أَرَی لَکُمْ أَنْ تَعَمَّدُوا إِلَی قَبَائِلِکُمُ الْعَشَرَةِ فَتَنْتَدِبُوا مِنْ کُلِّ قَبِیلَةٍ مِنْهَا 31.en:
Hind ibn Abi Halah narrated: Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, used to protect His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) through his uncle Abu Talib (peace be upon him), such that no one from his people could reach him with harm during his lifetime. When Abu Talib died, the Quraysh reached their goal regarding the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). They inflicted great harm upon him, to the point that they left him abandoned. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said, "O Uncle, how quickly we have felt the loss of you! May your kinship be rewarded, and may you be recompensed with goodness, O Uncle." Then Khadija (peace be upon her) died one month after Abu Talib (peace be upon him). Thus, two sorrows gathered upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), to the extent that it was visible upon him.

Hind said: Then the influential and noble men of Quraysh went to Dar al-Nadwa to deliberate and conspire against the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), keeping it secret among themselves. Some said, "Let us build a structure for him and leave openings, imprisoning him within it. No one from those who follow his religion will be able to reach him, and we will remain in comfort until the decree of death comes to him." The authors of this suggestion were al-As ibn Wa'il, and Umayya and Ubayy, the sons of Khalaf. Another said, "No, this is not a good opinion for you. If you do that, his close friends and allies will become enraged. Then the seasons and the sacred months will arrive with security, and he will be snatched from your trap. Speak your minds."

Utba, Shayba, and Abu Sufyan said, "We suggest that we mount him on a difficult camel, bind Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) securely upon it, and then drive the camel with the tips of our spears so that it may tear him limb from limb among the dunes." The leader of their council said, "You have not accomplished anything with this suggestion. Do you not see that if the camel reaches some of the tribes safely, he will capture their hearts with his magic, his eloquence, and his fluent speech? The people will convert to his side, and the tribes will respond to him one by one. Then he will march against you with battalions and armies, and you will perish just as the tribe of Iyad and those before you perished. Speak your minds."

Abu Jahl said to him, "I suggest that you go to your ten tribes and select a brave man from each. Then arm them with sharp swords, and let these youths prepare. When the night grows dark and deep, they shall launch a sudden attack on Ibn Abi Kabsha [the Prophet], so that his blood will be distributed among all the tribes of Quraysh. The Banu Hashim and Banu al-Muttalib will not be able to fight all the tribes of Quraysh for their kinsman, and they will be satisfied with accepting the blood money from us." The leader of their council said, "You have hit the mark, O Abu al-Hakam." He then turned to them and said, "This is the opinion; do not deviate from it, and keep your mouths shut until your plan is secured."

The people departed in groups, but Gabriel (peace be upon him) had already preceded them with revelation regarding their plot. He recited this verse to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): "And when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners." (8:30).

When Gabriel (peace be upon him) informed him of Allah's command regarding this and His revelation, and what He had decreed for him regarding the migration, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) called for Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) at that moment. He said to him, "O Ali, the Spirit (Gabriel) has just descended upon me with this verse, informing me that the Quraysh have gathered to plot against me and kill me. It has been revealed to me from my Lord, the Almighty and Majestic, that I should leave the home of my people and set out for the Cave of Thawr tonight. He has commanded me to order you to sleep in my bed—or he said, 'my resting place'—so that your sleeping there may conceal my tracks. What do you say and what will you do?" Ali (peace be upon him) said, "Will you be safe if I sleep there, O Prophet of Allah?" He replied, "Yes." Ali (peace be upon him) smiled, laughing, and fell to the ground in prostration, thanking Allah for what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had told him regarding his [the Prophet's] safety. Thus, Ali (peace be upon him) was the first of this nation to prostrate to Allah in gratitude, and the first to place his face upon the earth after his prostration, following the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

31.ar: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) قَدْ کَانَ لَقِیَ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ بَلَاءً شَدِیداً حَتَّی أَتَوْهُ ذَاتَ یَوْمٍ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ حَتَّی طَرَحُوا عَلَیْهِ رَحِمَ شَاةٍ فَأَتَتْهُ ابْنَتُهُ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ لَمْ یَرْفَعْ رَأْسَهُ فَرَفَعَتْهُ عَنْهُ وَ مَسَحَتْهُ ثُمَّ أَرَاهُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِکَ الَّذِی یُحِبُّ أَنَّهُ کَانَ بِبَدْرٍ وَ لَیْسَ مَعَهُ غَیْرُ فَارِسٍ وَاحِدٍ ثُمَّ کَانَ مَعَهُ یَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفاً حَتَّی جَعَلَ أَبُوسُفْیَانَ وَ الْمُشْرِکُونَ یَسْتَغِیثُونَ.
31.fa: امام باقر (- همانا رسول خدا (از قومش آزارهای بسیاری دید. روزی هنگامی‌که درحال سجود بود، شکنبه‌ی گوسفندی بر وی انداختند. دخترش نزد او آمد و در همان حالی که پیامبر (در سجده بود، آنچه را مشرکان بر وی انداخته بودند، از سرش برداشت و [سر و روی پدر را] پاک کرد. سپس خدا آنچه را دوست می‌داشت به وی نشان داد. او در بدر بود درحالی‌که فقط یک سوارکار همراه او بود و هنگامی‌که روز فتح فرا رسید، دوازده‌هزار نفر همراه او بودند به‌طوری‌که ابوسفیان و مشرکان مجبور شدند از او طلب کمک کنند.
31.en: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had endured severe affliction from his people, to the extent that one day, while he was prostrating, they threw the womb of a sheep upon him. His daughter came to him while he was still in prostration and had not yet raised his head; she removed it from him and wiped him clean. Thereafter, Allah showed him what he loved: he was at Badr with no one accompanying him but a single horseman, and then, on the day of the Conquest, twelve thousand men were with him, to the point that Abu Sufyan and the polytheists were forced to seek his aid.

31.ar: کَانَ سَبَبُ نُزُولِهَا أَنَّهُ لَمَّا أَظْهَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) الدَّعْوَةَ بِمَکَّةَ قَدِمَتْ عَلَیْهِ الْأَوْسُ وَ الْخَزْرَجُ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) تَمْنَعُونِّی وَ تَکُونُونَ لِی جَاراً حَتَّی أَتْلُوَ عَلَیْکُمْ کِتَابَ رَبِّی وَ ثَوَابُکُمْ عَلَی اللَّهِ الْجَنَّةُ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ خُذْ لِرَبِّکَ وَ لِنَفْسِکَ مَا شِئْتَ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ مَوْعِدُکُمُ الْعَقَبَةُ فِی اللَّیْلَةِ الْوُسْطَی مِنْ لَیَالِی التَّشْرِیقِ فَحَجُّوا وَ رَجَعُوا إِلَی مِنًی وَ کَانَ فِیهِمْ مِمَّنْ قَدْ حَجَّ بَشَرٌ کَثِیرٌ فَلَمَّا کَانَ الْیَوْمُ الثَّانِی مِنْ أَیَّامِ التَّشْرِیقِ قَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِذَا کَانَ اللَّیْلُ فَاحْضُرُوا دَارَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ عَلَی الْعَقَبَةِ وَ لَا تُنَبِّهُوا نَائِماً وَ لْیَنْسِلْ وَاحِدٌ فَوَاحِدٌ فَجَاءَ سَبْعُونَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَوْسِ وَ الْخَزْرَجِ فَدَخَلُوا الدَّارَ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) تَمْنَعُونِّی وَ تُجِیرُونِّی حَتَّی أَتْلُوَ عَلَیْکُمْ کِتَابَ رَبِّی وَ ثَوَابُکُمْ عَلَی اللَّهِ الْجَنَّةُ فَقَالَ أَسْعَدُ بْنُ زُرَارَةَ وَ الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ مَعْرُورٍ وَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حِزَامٍ نَعَمْ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) اشْتَرِطْ لِرَبِّکَ وَ لِنَفْسِکَ مَا شِئْتَ فَقَالَ أَمَّا مَا أَشْتَرِطُ لِرَبِّی فَأَنْ تَعْبُدُوهُ وَ لَا تُشْرِکُوا بِهِ شَیْئاً وَ أَشْتَرِطُ لِنَفْسِی أَنْ تَمْنَعُونِی مِمَّا تَمْنَعُونَ أَنْفُسَکُمْ وَ تَمْنَعُونَ أَهْلِی مِمَّا تَمْنَعُونَ أَهَالِیَکُمْ وَ أَوْلَادَکُمْ فَقَالُوا فَمَا لَنَا عَلَی ذَلِکَ فَقَالَ الْجَنَّةُ فِی الْآخِرَةِ وَ تَمْلِکُونَ الْعَرَبَ وَ تَدِینُ لَکُمُ الْعَجَمُ فِی الدُّنْیَا وَ تَکُونُونَ مُلُوکاً فِی الْجَنَّةِ فَقَالُوا قَدْ رَضِینَا فَقَالَ أَخْرِجُوا إِلَیَّ مِنْکُمُ اثْنَیْ عَشَرَ نَقِیباً یَکُونُونَ شُهَدَاءَ عَلَیْکُمْ بِذَلِکَ کَمَا أَخَذَ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) مِنْ بَنِی إِسْرَائِیل.
31.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- سبب نزول این آیه چنین است؛ هنگامی‌که رسول خدا (دعوت خود را در مکّه آشکارا آغاز فرمود [گروهی از] قبیله‌ی اوس و خزرج، نزد ایشان آمدند، رسول خدا (به آن‌ها فرمود: «آیا از من حمایت می‌کنید و مرا پناه می‌دهید تا کتاب پروردگارم را برایتان بخوانم [و شما ایمان بیاورید] و [در مقابل] اجر و پاداش شما نزد خداوند بهشت باشد»؟ عرض کردند: «آری، هر عهد و پیمانی که برای پروردگارت و خودت می‌خواهی [از ما] بگیر». پیامبر (فرمود: «وعده‌گاه من و شما در عقبه در شب دوّم از شب‌های تشریق (دوازدهم ذی‌الحجّه) باشد». آن‌ها [از حضرت (جداشده و] مناسک حجّ را به‌جا آوردند و به سرزمین منی بازگشتند و آن سال با ایشان، جمع بسیاری [از اوس و خزرج] نیز به حجّ آمده بودند. چون روز دوّم از روزهای تشریق (دوازدهم ذی‌الحجّه) فرا رسید رسول خدا (به آن‌ها فرمود: «شب هنگام، در خانه‌ی عبدالمطلّب در عقبه حاضر شوید و خفته‌ای را بیدار نسازید و یکی پس از دیگری وارد شوید». در آن شب هفتاد نفر از اوس و خزرج وارد خانه‌ی عبدالمطلّب شدند. رسول خدا (به آن‌ها فرمود: «آیا از من حمایت می‌کنید و مرا پناه می‌دهید تا کتاب پروردگارم را برایتان بخوانم [و شما ایمان بیاورید] و [در مقابل] اجر و پاداش شما نزد خداوند بهشت باشد»؟ اسعدبن‌زراره، براءبن‌معرور و عبداللّه‌بن‌حزام عرض کردند: «آری ای رسول خدا (! هر شرط و پیمانی که برای پروردگارت و خودت می‌خواهی بیان فرما». پیامبر (فرمود: «آنچه برای پروردگارم از شما پیمان می‌گیرم این است که او را پرستش‌کرده و هرگز برای او شریکی قرار ندهید و آنچه برای خودم پیمان می‌گیرم این است که از من و خانواده‌ی من، همان‌طور که از خود و خانواده و فرزندانتان حمایت می‌نمایید حمایت کنید». عرض کردند: «در قبال انجام این کارها اجر و پاداش ما چیست»؟ حضرت (فرمود: «در آخرت، بهشت است و در دنیا بر عرب مسلّط شده و غیرعرب نیز به دین شما در خواهد آمد و در بهشت نیز از بزرگان خواهید بود». عرض کردند: «[به این عهد و پیمان] راضی و خشنود هستیم». پیامبر (فرمود: «دوازده نفر سرکرده از خودتان [انتخاب و] به من معرّفی کنید تا شاهد و گواه شما بر این عهد و پیمان باشند، چنان‌که موسی (دوازده نفر از بنی‌اسرائیل را برگزید».
31.en: The reason for its revelation is that when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) made his call public in Mecca, the Aws and the Khazraj came to him. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to them, "Will you protect me and be my sanctuary until I recite to you the Book of my Lord, and your reward from Allah will be Paradise?" They replied, "Yes, take for your Lord and for yourself whatever you wish." He said to them, "Our meeting place shall be at al-Aqaba on the middle night of the days of Tashriq." They performed the Hajj and returned to Mina, and among them were many who had performed the Hajj. When the second day of the days of Tashriq arrived, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to them, "When night falls, gather at the house of Abd al-Muttalib at al-Aqaba; do not wake anyone who is sleeping, and let each one come one by one." Seventy men from the Aws and the Khazraj came and entered the house. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to them, "Will you protect me and grant me sanctuary until I recite to you the Book of my Lord, and your reward from Allah will be Paradise?" As'ad ibn Zurara, al-Bara' ibn Ma'rur, and Abdullah ibn Hizam said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah, stipulate for your Lord and for yourself whatever you wish." He said, "As for what I stipulate for my Lord, it is that you worship Him and do not associate anything with Him. And I stipulate for myself that you protect me as you protect yourselves, and protect my family as you protect your own families and children." They asked, "And what will we have for that?" He replied, "Paradise in the Hereafter, and you will rule over the Arabs, the non-Arabs will submit to your religion in this world, and you will be kings in Paradise." They said, "We are satisfied." He then said, "Bring forth from among you twelve leaders who will be witnesses over you for this, just as Moses (peace be upon him) took from the Children of Israel."
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), vol. 5, p. 532

31.ar: ثُمَّ قَالُوا لِإِبْلِیسَ فَمَا الرَّأْیُ فِیهِ یَا شَیْخُ قَالَ مَا فِیهِ إِلَّا رَأْیٌ وَاحِدٌ قَالُوا وَ مَا هِیَ قَالَ یَجْتَمِعُ مِنْ کُلِّ بَطْنٍ مِنْ بُطُونِ قُرَیْشٍ وَ قَبَائِلِ الْعَرَبِ مَا أَمْکَنَ وَ یَکُونُ مَعَهُمْ مِنْ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ رَجُلٌ فَیَأْخُذُونَ سِکِّینَةً أَوْ حَدِیدَةً أَوْ سَیْفاً فَیَدْخُلُونَ عَلَیْهِ فَیَضْرِبُونَهُ کُلُّهُمْ ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً حَتَّی یَتَفَرَّقَ دَمُهُ فِی قُرَیْشٍ کُلِّهَا فَلَا یَسْتَطِیعُ بَنُوهَاشِمٍ أَنْ یَطْلُبُوا بِدَمِهِ وَ قَدْ شَارَکُوهُ فِیهِ فَإِنْ سَأَلُوکُمْ أَنْ تُعْطُوهُمُ الدِّیَةَ فَأَعْطُوهُمْ ثَلَاثَ دِیَاتٍ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ وَ عَشْرَ دِیَاتٍ ثُمَّ قَالُوا الرَّأْیُ رَأْیُ الشَّیْخِ النَّجْدِیِّ فَاجْتَمَعُوا فِیهِ وَ دَخَلَ مَعَهُمْ فِی ذَلِکَ أَبُولَهَبٍ عَمُّ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ نَزَلَ جَبْرَئِیلُ (علیه السلام) عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ قُرَیْشاً قَدِ اجْتَمَعَتْ فِی دَارِ النَّدْوَةِ یُدَبِّرُونَ عَلَیْکَ وَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ فِی ذَلِکَ وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ أَوْ یُخْرِجُوکَ وَ یَمْکُرُونَ وَ یَمْکُرُ اللهُ وَ اللهُ خَیْرُ الْماکِرِینَ وَ اجْتَمَعَتْ قُرَیْشٌ أَنْ یَدْخُلُوا عَلَیْهِ لَیْلًا فَیَقْتُلُوه.
31.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- بزرگان قریش خطاب به ابلیس [که به صورت پیرمردی بر آن‌ها ظاهر گشته بود] گفتند: «ای پیرمرد! پس نظر درست در این رابطه چیست»؟ ابلیس گفت: «در این رابطه یک نظر بیشتر درست نیست». پرسیدند: «آن یک نظر چیست»؟ گفت: «از هر طایفه از طوایفِ مختلف قریش و دیگر قبایل عرب به همراه یک نفر از بنی‌هاشم، در حدّ امکان افرادی گردهم آیند و چاقو یا ابزاری آهنین یا شمشیری همراه خود برداشته و بر محمّد (هجوم آورند و هرکدام ضربه‌ای بر او وارد کنند تا خون وی در میان تمام قریش پراکنده گردد، به این ترتیب چون بنی‌هاشم خود نیز در کُشتن او مشارکت داشته‌اند نمی‌توانند خون او را مطالبه کنند و اگر از شما دیه طلب کردند دیه‌ی سه نفر را به ایشان بدهید». گفتند: «آری، بلکه دیه‌ی ده نفر را می‌دهیم و نظر درست، همین نظر پیرمردِ نجدی است». و بر این نظر توافق کردند و ابولهب، عموی پیامبر (نیز [به‌عنوان فردی از بنی‌هاشم] جزو گروه مهاجم ش-د. جبرئیل بر رسول خدا (نازل شده و به ایش-ان خبر داد که قریش در دارالنّدوه جمع‌شده و برضدّ شما اندیشه می‌کنند، و خداوند نازل فرمود: وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ أَوْ یُخْرِجُوکَ وَ یَمْکُرُونَ وَ یَمْکُرُ اللهُ وَ اللهُ خَیْرُ الْماکِرِینَ، و قریش توافق کردند که شبانه بر پیامبر (هجوم آورده و ایشان را به قتل برسانند.
31.en: Then they said to Iblis, "What is the opinion regarding him, O Elder?" He said, "There is only one opinion regarding him." They asked, "And what is it?" He said, "Gather from every clan of the clans of Quraysh and the tribes of the Arabs as many as possible, and include with them a man from the Banu Hashim. Let them take a knife, an iron tool, or a sword, and enter upon him and strike him all at once with a single blow, so that his blood is dispersed among all of Quraysh. Thus, the Banu Hashim will not be able to seek blood money for him, as they will have participated in it. If they ask you to pay the blood money, give them three times the blood money." They said, "Yes, and even ten times the blood money." Then they said, "The opinion is the opinion of the Najdi Elder." They agreed upon this, and Abu Lahab, the uncle of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), joined them in this. Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) and informed him that the Quraysh had gathered in the Dar al-Nadwa plotting against him. God revealed regarding this: "And when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you, or kill you, or drive you out; and they plot, and God plots, and God is the best of plotters." The Quraysh agreed to enter upon him at night and kill him.

31.ar: ٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ (رحمة الله علیه) فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا قَالَ تَشَاوَرَتْ قُرَیْشٌ لَیْلَةً بِمَکَّةَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ {مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله)} فَأَوْثِقُوهُ بِالْوَثَاقِ. وَ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: اقْتُلُوهُ. وَ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: بَلْ أَخْرِجُوهُ- فَأَطْلَعَ اللَّهُ نَبِیَّهُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) عَلَی ذَلِکَ، فَبَاتَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) عَلَی فِرَاشِ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) تِلْکَ اللَّیْلَةَ، فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) حَتَّی لَحِقَ بِالْغَارِ، وَ بَاتَ الْمُشْرِکُونَ یَحْرُسُونَ عَلِیّاً (علیه السلام) وَ هُمْ یَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله)، فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحُوا ثَارُوا إِلَیْهِ، فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا عَلِیّاً (علیه السلام) رَدَّ اللَّهُ مَکْرَهُمْ فَقَالُوا أَیْنَ صَاحِبُکَ قَالَ لَا أَدْرِی. فَاقْتَصُّوا أَثَرَهُ فَلَمَّا بَلَغُوا الْجَبَلَ اخْتَلَطَ عَلَیْهِمْ فَصَعِدُوا فَوْقَ الْجَبَلِ فَمَرُّوا بِالْغَارِ فَرَأَوْا عَلَی بَابِهِ نَسْجَ الْعَنْکَبُوتِ فَقَالُوا لَوْ دَخَلَ هَاهُنَا لَمْ یَکُنْ عَلَی بَابِهِ نَسْجُ الْعَنْکَبُوت.
31.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا؛ طائفه‌ای از قریش مکّه تصمیم خطرناکی درباره‌ی پیامبر (گرفتند. تا آن تصمیم را در یک شب اجرا کنند. بعضی از آنان گفتند: «محمّد (را بکُشیم»؛ عدّه‌ای گفتند: «او را از شهر بیرون کنیم»؛ دسته‌ای دیگر گفتند: «او را سخت مجازات کنیم». خداوند خبیر، مصطفی (را از نیّات پلید آنان مطّلع گردانید. آن شب، امام علی (در بستر پیامبر (جای گرفت، تا فدایی برادرش شود. محمّد (از شهر خارج شد و در غار پناه گرفت، مشرکین هم خانه را محاصره کرده، سخت از آن مراقبت می‌کردند تا مبادا رسول خدا (از آن خارج شود؛ غافل از اینکه علی (در خانه‌ی پیامبر (آرمیده است. چون در سحرگاه آن شب علی (را دیدند، فهمیدند، فریب خورده‌اند. پس پرسیدند: «ای علی (! رفیق و مصاحب تو کجاست»؟ علی (فرمود: «نمی‌دانم کجاست». آن جماعت مشرک به تعقیب رسول خدا (شتافتند و ردّپای آن حضرت (را تا پای کوه دنبال کردند، وقتی به دهانه‌ی غاری که آنجا بود رسیدند، بر در آن، تار عنکبوت را بافته دیدند. گفتند: «اگر محمّد (داخل غار می‌شد، تار عنکبوت باید از بین می‌رفت»، در نهایت از رفتن به داخل غار منصرف شدند و به بالای کوه شتافتند.
31.en: Regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted, "And when those who disbelieved plotted against you," Ibn Abbas said: The Quraysh consulted one night in Mecca. Some of them said, "When morning comes, bind Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) in chains." Others said, "Kill him." Others said, "Rather, expel him." Allah informed His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) of this. That night, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) slept in the bed of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) went out until he reached the cave. The polytheists spent the night guarding Ali (peace be upon him), thinking he was the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). When they reached the morning, they rose up against him. When they saw Ali (peace be upon him), Allah turned back their plot. They asked, "Where is your companion?" He replied, "I do not know." They followed his tracks until they reached the mountain, where the trail became confused for them. They climbed the mountain and passed by the cave, where they saw a spider's web at its entrance. They said, "If he had entered here, there would not be a spider's web at its entrance."

31.ar: ثُمَّ اجْتَمَعَتْ قُرَیْشٌ فِی دَارِ النَّدْوَةِ ... فَجَاءَهُمُ الْمَلْعُونُ إِبْلِیسُ ... فَلَمَّا أَخَذُوا مَجْلِسَهُمْ قَالَ أَبُو جَهْلٍ یَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَیْشٍ إِنَّهُ لَمْ یَکُنْ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ أَعَزَّ مِنَّا ٌ ... حَتَّی نَشَأَ فِینَا مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَکُنَّا نُسَمِّیهِ أَلْأَمِینَ لِصَلَاحِهِ وَ أَمَانَتِهِ فَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِینَ (صلی الله علیه و آله) سَبَّ آلِهَتَنَا ... وَ قَدْ رَأَیْتُ فِیهِ رَأْیاً وَ هُوَ أَنْ نَدُسَّ إِلَیْهِ رَجُلًا یَقْتُلُهُ فَإِنْ طَلَبَتْ بَنُو هَاشِمٍ دَمَهُ أَعْطَیْنَاهُمْ عَشْرَ دِیَاتٍ. فَقَالَ إِبْلِیسُ هَذَا رَأْیٌ خَبِیثٌ فَإِنَّ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ لَا تَرْضَی أَنْ یَمْشِیَ قَاتِلُ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) عَلَی الْأَرْضِ أَبَداً وَ یَقَعُ بَیْنَکُمُ الْحُرُوبُ فِی حَرَمِکُمْ. فَقَالَ آخِرُ الرَّأْیِ أَنْ نَأْخُذَهُ وَ نَحْبِسَهُ فِی بَیْتٍ وَ نُثَبِّتَهُ فِیهِ وَ نُلْقِیَ إِلَیْهِ قُوتَه حَتَّی یَمُوتَ کَمَا مَاتَ زُهَیْرٌ وَ النَّابِغَةُ. فَقَالَ إِبْلِیسُ إِنَّ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ لَا تَرْضَی بِذَلِکَ فَإِذَا جَاءَ مَوْسِمُ الْعَرَبِ اجْتَمَعُوا عَلَیْکُمْ وَ أَخْرَجُوهُ فَیَخْدَعُهُمْ بِسِحْرِهِ. وَ قَالَ آخِرُ الرَّأْیِ أَنْ نُخْرِجَهُ مِنْ بِلَادِنَا وَ نَطْرُدَهُ فَنَفْرَغَ لِآلِهَتِنَا. فَقَالَ إِبْلِیسُ هَذَا أَخْبَثُ مِنَ الرَّأْیَیْنِ الْمُتَقَدِّمَیْنِ لِأَنَّکُمْ ... فَلَا یَفْجَأُکُمْ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ مَلَأَهَا عَلَیْکُمْ خَیْلًا وَ رَجِلًا فَبَقُوا حَیَارَی. ثُمَّ قَالُوا لِلْمَلْعُونِ إِبْلِیسَ فَمَا الرَّأْیُ عِنْدَکَ فِیهِ قَالَ مَا فِیهِ إِلَّا رَأْیٌ وَاحِدٌ أَنْ یَجْتَمِعَ مِنْ کُلِّ بَطْنٍ مِنْ بُطُونِ قُرَیْشٍ رَجُلٌ شَرِیفٌ وَ یَکُونَ مَعَکُمْ مِنْ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ وَاحِدٌ فَیَأْخُذُونَ سَیْفاً وَ یَدْخُلُونَ عَلَیْهِ فَیَضْرِبُونَهُ کُلُّهُمْ ضَرْبَةً وَاحِدَةً فَیَتَفَرَّقُ دَمُهُ فِی قُرَیْشٍ کُلِّهَا فَلَا یَسْتَطِیعُ بَنُو هَاشِمٍ أَنْ یَطْلُبُوا بِدَمِهِ وَ قَدْ شَارَکُوا فِیهِ فَمَا بَقِیَ لَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ تُعْطُوهُمُ الدِّیَةَ ... قَالُوا بِأَجْمَعِهِمْ الرَّأْیُ رَأْیُ الشَّیْخِ النَّجْدِیِّ فَاخْتَارُوا خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ رَجُلًا فِیهِمْ أَبُولَهَبٍ عَلَی أَنْ یَدْخُلُوا عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ عَلَی رَسُولِهِ وَ إِذْ یَمْکُرُ بِکَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا لِیُثْبِتُوکَ أَوْ یَقْتُلُوکَ أَوْ یُخْرِجُوکَ وَ یَمْکُرُونَ وَ یَمْکُرُ اللهُ وَ اللهُ خَیْرُ الْماکِرِینَ ... وَ أَجْمَعُوا أَنْ یَدْخُلُوا عَلَیْهِ لَیْلًا وَ کَتَمُوا أَمْرَهُمْ فَقَالَ أَبُولَهَبٍ بَلْ نَحْرُسُهُ فَإِذَا أَصْبَحْنَا دَخَلْنَا عَلَیْهِ فَبَاتُوا حَوْلَ حُجْرَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَنْ یُفْرَشَ لَهُ وَ قَالَ لِعَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام)یَا عَلِیُّ افْدِنِی بِنَفْسِکَ قَالَ نَعَمْ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) قَالَ لَهُ نَمْ عَلَی فِرَاشِی وَ الْتَحِفْ بِبُرْدِی فَنَامَ (فقام)(علیه السلام) ... وَ جَاءَ جَبْرَئِیلُ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ لَهُ اخْرُجْ وَ الْقَوْمُ أَشْرَفُوا عَلَی الْحُجْرَةِ فَیَرَوْنَ فِرَاشَهُ وَ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) نَائِمٌ عَلَیْهِ فَیَتَوَهَّمُونَ أَنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) عَلَیْهِمْ وَ هُوَ یَقْرَأُ یس إِلَی قَوْلِهِ فَأَغْشَیْناهُمْ فَهُمْ لا یُبْصِرُونَ وَ أَخَذَ تُرَاباً بِکَفِّهِ وَ نَثَرَهُ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ هُمْ نِیَامٌ وَ مَضَی.
31.en: Then the Quraysh gathered in the Dar al-Nadwa... and the accursed Iblis came to them... When they had taken their seats, Abu Jahl said, "O people of Quraysh, there was no one among the Arabs more honorable than us... until Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) grew up among us. We used to call him 'al-Amin' (the Trustworthy) for his righteousness and honesty, but then he claimed to be the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds and insulted our gods... I have an opinion regarding him: that we send a man to kill him. If the Banu Hashim demand his blood, we will pay them ten blood-monies." Iblis said, "This is a wicked opinion, for the Banu Hashim will never be satisfied with the killer of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) walking on the earth, and wars will break out among you in your sanctuary." Another said, "The final opinion is that we take him, imprison him in a house, secure him there, and throw his sustenance to him until he dies, just as Zuhayr and al-Nabigha died." Iblis said, "The Banu Hashim will not be satisfied with that; when the Arab season (pilgrimage) comes, they will gather against you, release him, and he will deceive them with his magic." Another said, "The final opinion is that we expel him from our lands and drive him away, so we may be free for our gods." Iblis said, "This is more wicked than the two previous opinions, because you... will be surprised when he fills the land against you with cavalry and infantry," and they remained bewildered. Then they said to the accursed Iblis, "What is your opinion regarding him?" He said, "There is only one opinion: that a noble man be gathered from every clan of the Quraysh, and one from the Banu Hashim be with you. They shall take a sword, enter upon him, and strike him all at once with a single blow, so that his blood is dispersed among all the Quraysh. The Banu Hashim will not be able to demand his blood, for they will have participated in it, and nothing will remain for them but to accept the blood-money." They all said, "The opinion is the opinion of the Najdi elder." They chose fifteen men, among them Abu Lahab, to enter upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). Then Allah, the Exalted, revealed to His Messenger: "And when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you, or kill you, or evict you; and they plan, and Allah plans. And Allah is the best of planners." They agreed to enter upon him at night and kept their affair secret. Abu Lahab said, "Rather, we shall guard him, and when morning comes, we will enter upon him." So they spent the night around the chamber of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered that his bed be prepared and said to Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), "O Ali, sacrifice yourself for me." He said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." He told him, "Sleep in my bed and cover yourself with my cloak." He (peace be upon him) slept... Then Gabriel (peace be upon him) came and said to him, "Go out." The people were overlooking the chamber, seeing his bed with Ali (peace be upon him) sleeping on it, and they imagined it was the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) went out to them while reciting [Surah] Yasin up to His saying: "And We have covered them, so they do not see." He took a handful of dust in his palm, scattered it upon them while they were sleeping, and passed by.

32.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ عنه (علیه السلام) قَال: بَیْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) ذَاتَ یَوْمٍ جَالِساً إِذْ أَقْبَلَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِنَّ فِیکَ شَبَهاً مِنْ عِیسَی ابْنِ مَرْیَمَ (علیه السلام) وَ لَوْ لَا أَنْ تَقُولَ فِیکَ طَوَائِفُ مِنْ أُمَّتِی مَا قَالَتِ النَّصَارَی فِی عِیسَی ابْنِ مَرْیَمَ (علیه السلام) لَقُلْتُ فِیکَ قَوْلًا لَا تَمُرُّ بِمَلَإٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ إِلَّا أَخَذُوا التُّرَابَ مِنْ تَحْتِ قَدَمَیْکَ یَلْتَمِسُونَ بِذَلِکَ الْبَرَکَةَ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ الْأَعْرَابِیَّانِ وَ الْمُغِیرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ وَ عِدَّةٌ مِنْ قُرَیْشٍ مَعَهُمْ فَقَالُوا مَا رَضِیَ أَنْ یَضْرِبَ لِابْنِ عَمِّهِ مَثَلًا إِلَّا عِیسَی ابْنَ مَرْیَمَ (علیه السلام) فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَی نَبِیِّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَقَالَ وَ لَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْیَمَ مَثَلًا إِذا قَوْمُکَ مِنْهُ یَصِدُّونَ وَ قالُوا أَ آلِهَتُنا خَیْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ما ضَرَبُوهُ لَکَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنا عَلَیْهِ وَ جَعَلْناهُ مَثَلًا لِبَنِی إِسْرائِیلَ وَ لَوْ نَشاءُ لَجَعَلْنا مِنْکُمْ یَعْنِی مِنْ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ مَلائِکَةً فِی الْأَرْضِ یَخْلُفُونَ قَالَ فَغَ-ضِبَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَمْ-رٍو الْفِهْ-رِیُّ فَقَالَ اللَّ-هُمَّ إِنْ کانَ ه-ذا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْ-دِکَ أَنَّ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ یَتَوَارَثُونَ هِرَقْلًا بَعْدَ هِرَقْلٍ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَیْنا حِجارَةً مِنَ السَّماءِ أَوِ ائْتِنا بِعَذابٍ أَلِیمٍ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ مَقَالَةَ الْحَارِث وَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ لِیُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ أَنْتَ فِیهِمْ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ هُمْ یَسْتَغْفِرُون.
32.en:
Abu Basir narrated from him (peace be upon him) who said: One day, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was sitting when the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) approached. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him, "You have a resemblance to Jesus, son of Mary (peace be upon him). Were it not for the fear that factions of my nation might say about you what the Christians said about Jesus, son of Mary (peace be upon him), I would have said something about you such that you would not pass by a group of people without them taking the dust from beneath your feet, seeking blessings through it."

He said: The two Bedouins, al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, and a group of Quraysh who were with them became angry and said, "He is not satisfied until he strikes a comparison for his cousin with none other than Jesus, son of Mary (peace be upon him)." Then Allah revealed to His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): "And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud at it. And they said, 'Are our gods better, or is he?' They did not present the comparison except for argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute. Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. And if We willed, We could have made among you"—meaning from the Banu Hashim—"angels succeeding each other on the earth." (Zukhruf: 57-60).

He said: Al-Harith ibn 'Amr al-Fihri became angry and said, "O Allah, if this is the truth from You—that the Banu Hashim will inherit [power] like Heraclius after Heraclius—then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment." Then Allah revealed to His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) the statement of al-Harith, and this verse was revealed: "But Allah would not punish them while you, [O Muhammad], are among them, and Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness."

32.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 8, p. 57; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 35, p. 323

32.ar: وَ إِذْ قالُوا اللهُمَّ إِنْ کانَ هذا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِکَ الْآیَةَ فَإِنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ لَمَّا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لِقُرَیْشٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَعَثَنِی أَنْ أَقْتُلَ جَمِیعَ مُلُوکِ الدُّنْیَا وَ أَجُرَّ الْمُلْکَ إِلَیْکُمْ فَأَجِیبُونِی إِلَی مَا أَدْعُوکُمْ إِلَیْهِ تَمْلِکُوا بِهَا الْعَرَبَ وَ تَدِینُ لَکُمْ بِهَا الْعَجَمُ وَ تَکُونُوا مُلُوکاً فِی الْجَنَّةِ فَقَالَ أَبُوجَهْلٍ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ کانَ هذا الَّذِی یَقُولُ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِکَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَیْنا حِجارَةً مِنَ السَّماءِ أَوِ ائْتِنا بِعَذابٍ أَلِیم حَسَداً لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) ثُمَّ قَالَ کُنَّا وَ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ کَفَرَسَیْ رِهَانٍ نَحْمِلُ إِذَا حَمَلُوا وَ نَظْعَنُ إِذَا ظَعَنُوا وَ نُوقِدُ إِذَا أَوْقَدُوا فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَی بِنَا وَ بِهِمُ الرَّکْبُ قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ مِنَّا نَبِیٌّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لَا نَرْضَی بِذَلِکَ أَنْ یَکُونَ فِی بَنِی هَاشِمٍ وَ لَایَکُونَ فِی بَنِی مَخْزُومٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ غُفْرَانَکَ اللَّهُمَّ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِی ذَلِکَ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ لِیُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ أَنْتَ فِیهِمْ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ هُمْ یَسْتَغْفِرُونَ حِینَ قَالَ غُفْرَانَکَ اللَّهُمَّ فَلَمَّا هَمُّوا بِقَتْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَخْرَجُوهُ مِنْ مَکَّةَ قَالَ اللَّهُ وَ ما لَهُمْ أَلَّا یُعَذِّبَهُمُ اللهُ وَ هُمْ یَصُدُّونَ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرامِ وَ ما کانُوا أَوْلِیاءَهُ یَعْنِی قُرَیْشاً مَا کَانُوا أَوْلِیَاءَ مَکَّةَ إِنْ أَوْلِیاؤُهُ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقُونَ أَنْتَ وَ أَصْحَابُکَ یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَعَذَّبَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِالسَّیْفِ یَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فَقُتِلُوا.
32.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- این آیه: إِذْ قالُوا اللهُمَّ إِنْ کانَ هذا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِکَ هنگامی نازل شد که رسول خدا (به قریش فرمود: «همانا خدا مرا فرستاد تا همه‌ی پادشاهان عالم را بکُشم و پادشاهی را از آن شما سازم. پس دعوت مرا بپذیرید تا با آن بر عرب‌ها حکومت کنید و با آن عجم تابع شما شوند و در بهشت پادشاه و سرور باشید». ابوجهل گفت: «خداوندا! اگر آنچه محمّد (می‌گوید، این حقیقتی از سوی توست، بارانی از سنگ از آسمان بر ما فرو ریز، یا عذاب دردناکی برای ما بفرست». او این را از روی حسادت به رسول خدا (گفت. سپس گفت: «ما و بنی‌هاشم مانند اسبهای مسابقه (شرط‍‍‍‍بندی) بودیم. هرگاه آنان حمله می‌کردند، ما نیز حمله می‌کردیم و هرگاه با شمشیر می‌زدند، ما نیز می‌زدیم و هرگاه آتش برمی‌افروختند [برای میهمان‌نوازی] ما نیز آتش برمی‌افروختیم. پس هنگامی‌که هم‌رُتبه شدیم، یکی از آنان گفت: «من پیامبرم». ما نمی‌پذیریم که پیامبری از بنی‌هاشم باشد و از بنی‌مخزوم نباشد. سپس گفت: «خدایا از تو طلب آمرزش می‌کنم». پس خدا در این‌باره این آیه را نازل فرمود: ولی [ای پیامبر]! تا تو در میان آن‌ها هستی، خداوند آن‌ها را مجازات نخواهد کرد و [نیز] تا [گروهی از آن‌ها] استغفار می‌کنند، خدا عذابشان نمی‌کند؛ هنگامی‌که گفت: «خدایا از تو طلب آمرزش می‌کنم». پس هنگامی‌که خواستند رسول خدا (را بکُشند و او را از مکّه اخراج کنند، خداوند فرمود: چرا خدا آن‌ها را مجازات نکند، با اینکه آنان از [عبادت موحّدان در کنار] مسجد الحرام جلوگیری می‌کنند درحالی‌که سرپرست [و متولّی] آن نیستند؟! یعنی قریش که اولیای مکّه نبودند سرپرست آن، فقط پرهیزگارانند؛ یعنی تو و یارانت - ای محمّد (! - پس خدا آنان را در روز جنگ بدر به‌وسیله‌ی شمشیر، مورد عذاب خویش قرار داد، بنابراین کُشته شدند.
32.en: "And when they said, 'O Allah, if this is the truth from You...'" This verse was revealed when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to the Quraysh, "Indeed, Allah has sent me to defeat all the kings of the world and to bring sovereignty to you. So, accept what I call you to, that you may rule over the Arabs through it, the non-Arabs (Ajam) may submit to you, and you may be kings in Paradise." Abu Jahl said, "O Allah, if this which Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) says is the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment," out of envy for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). He then said, "We and the Banu Hashim were like two racehorses; when they attacked, we attacked; when they set out, we set out; and when they lit a fire [for hospitality], we lit a fire. But when we reached the same level, one of them said, 'I am a Prophet.' We do not accept that the Prophet should be from Banu Hashim and not from Banu Makhzum." Then he said, "I seek Your forgiveness, O Allah." Consequently, Allah revealed regarding this: "But Allah would not punish them while you, [O Muhammad], are among them, and Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness," referring to when he said, "I seek Your forgiveness, O Allah." Then, when they intended to kill the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and drove him out of Mecca, Allah said: "But why should Allah not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al-Haram and were not [its] guardians?" Meaning the Quraysh, who were not the guardians of Mecca. "Its guardians are not but the righteous," meaning you and your companions, O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). Thus, Allah punished them with the sword on the day of Badr, and they were killed.
32.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 5, p. 538

32.ar: جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ (علیه السلام) قَال: لَمَّا کَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِغَدِیرِ خُمٍّ نَادَی النَّاسَ فَاجْتَمَعُوا فَأَخَذَ بِیَدِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) وَ قَالَ مَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَعَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) مَوْلَاهُ فَشَاعَ ذَلِکَ فِی کُلِّ بَلَدٍ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِکَ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ النُّعْمَانِ الْفِهْرِیَّ فَأَتَی رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) عَلَی نَاقَةٍ لَهُ حَتَّی أَتَی الْأَبْطَحَ فَنَزَلَ عَنْ نَاقَتِهِ وَ أَنَاخَهَا وَ عَقَلَهَا ثُمَّ أَتَی النَّبِیَّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ هُوَ فِی مَلَإٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ قَالَ یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَمَرْتَنَا عَنِ اللَّهِ أَنْ نَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَ أَنَّکَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَقَبِلْنَاهُ وَ أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّیَ خَمْساً فَقَبِلْنَاه وَ أَمَرْتَنَا بِالْحَجِّ فَقَبِلْنَاهُ ثُمَّ لَمْ تَرْضَ بِذَلِکَ حَتَّی رَفَعْتَ بِضَبْعِ ابْنِ عَمِّکَ فَفَضَّلْتَهُ عَلَیْنَا وَ قُلْتَ مَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَعَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) مَوْلَاهُ أَ هَذَا شَیْءٌ مِنْ عِنْدِکَ أَمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ وَ اللَّهِ الَّذِی لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنَ اللَّهِ فَوَلَّی الْحَارِثُ یُرِیدُ رَاحِلَتَهُ وَ هُوَ یَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ کَانَ مَا یَقُولُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) حَقّاً فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَیْنا حِجارَةً مِنَ السَّماءِ أَوِ ائْتِنا بِعَذابٍ أَلِیمٍ فَمَا وَصَلَ إِلَیْهَا حَتَّی رَمَاهُ اللَّهُ بِحَجَرٍ فَسَقَطَ عَلَی هَامَتِهِ وَ خَرَجَ مِنْ دُبُرِهِ فَقَتَلَهُ.
32.fa: امام صادق (- امام صادق (از پدرانش نقل می‌کند: زمانی‌که رسول خدا (در غدیرخم بود مسلمانان را فراخوانده و آن‌ها گردهم آمدند، حضرت (دستان علی (را گرفته و فرمود: «هرکس من مولای او هستم علی (مولای اوست». این خبر در همه‌جا منتشر شده و به گوش حارث‌بن‌نعمان‌فهری رسید؛ او سوار بر شتری که داشت آهنگ پیامبر (کرد تا به سرزمین ابطح رسید و از شترش پایین آمد و آن را خوابانیده و دستانش را بست. آنگاه نزد پیامبر (که در میان گروهی از اصحابش بود آمده و عرض کرد: «ای محمّد (! از جانب خدا به ما دستور دادی شهادت دهیم معبودی جز خدای یگانه نیست و تو فرستاده‌ی خدایی، ما نیز پذیرفتیم؛ دستور دادی پنج نوبت نماز بجا آوریم، ما نیز پذیرفتیم؛ دستور انجام حجّ دادی، ما نیز پذیرفتیم؛ ولی به این دستورات راضی نشدی تا اینکه بازوی پسر عمویت را بالابرده و او را بر ما برتری دادی و گفتی هرکس من مولای او هستم علی مولای اوست، آیا این سخنی از پیش خودت می‌باشد یا دستوری از طرف خداست»؟ پیامبر (فرمود: «قس-م به خ-دایی که معبودی جز او نیست دستوری از ناحیه‌ی خداوند است». نعمان [با شنیدن این سخن] برگشت و به‌طرف شترش حرکت کرد درحالی‌که می‌گفت: «خداوندا! اگر آنچه محمّد (می‌گوید حقیقت دارد [و از ناحیه‌ی توست]، بارانی از سنگ از آسمان بر ما فرو ریز، یا عذاب دردناکی برای ما بفرست»؛ هنوز به شترش نرسیده بود که خداوند سنگی به‌سویش فرو فرستاد و بر مغزش فرود آمد و از پشتش خارج شد و او را به هلاکت رساند.
32.en: Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was at Ghadir Khumm, he called the people and they gathered. He took Ali's (peace be upon him) hand and said, "Whoever I am his master (mawla), then Ali (peace be upon him) is his master." This news spread to every land and reached al-Harith ibn al-Nu'man al-Fihri. He came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) riding his camel until he reached al-Abtah. He dismounted, made his camel kneel, and tied it. Then he came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) while he was among a group of his companions and said, "O Muhammad! You commanded us on behalf of Allah to testify that there is no god but Allah and that you are the Messenger of Allah, and we accepted it. You commanded us to pray five times, and we accepted it. You commanded us to perform Hajj, and we accepted it. Then you were not satisfied with that until you raised the arm of your cousin, favored him over us, and said, 'Whoever I am his master, then Ali (peace be upon him) is his master.' Is this something from yourself or from Allah?" He replied, "By the One besides whom there is no god, this is from Allah." Al-Harith turned away, heading toward his mount, saying, "O Allah, if what Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) says is the truth, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment." He had not yet reached his mount when Allah threw a stone at him; it fell upon his head, exited from his rear, and killed him.
32.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 5, p. 538
32.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 37, p. 136; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 37, p. 162; Nur al-Thaqalayn (with variations).

32.ar: عَنْ أَبِی هُرَیْرَةَ قَالَ: طُرِحَتِ الْأَقْتَابُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) یَوْمَ غَدِیرِ خُمٍّ قَالَ فَعَلَا عَلَیْهَا فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَی وَ أَثْنَی عَلَیْهِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِعَضُدِ أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) فَشَالَهَا وَ رَفَعَهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَهَذَا عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) مَوْلَاهُ اللَّهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ وَالَاهُ وَ عَادِ مَنْ عَادَاهُ وَ انْصُرْ مَنْ نَصَرَهُ وَ اخْذُلْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُ فَقَامَ إِلَیْهِ أَعْرَابِیٌّ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) دَعَوْتَنَا أَنْ نَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَ نَشْهَدَ أَنَّکَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَصَدَّقْنَا وَ أَمَرْتَنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ فَصَلَّیْنَا وَ بِالصِّیَامِ فَصُمْنَا وَ بِالْجِهَادِ فَجَاهَدْنَا وَ بِالزَّکَاةِ فَأَدَّیْنَا قَالَ وَ لَمْ یُقْنِعْکَ إِلَّا أَنْ أَخَذْتَ بِیَدِ هَذَا الْغُلَامِ عَلَی رُءُوسِ الْأَشْهَادِ فَقُلْتَ اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ کُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ فَعَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) مَوْلَاهُ فَهَذَا عَنِ اللَّهِ أَمْ عَنْکَ قَالَ (صلی الله علیه و آله) هَذَا عَنِ اللَّهِ لَا عَنِّی قَالَ اللَّهُ الَّذِی لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهَذَا عَنِ اللَّهِ لَا عَنْکَ قَالَ اللَّهُ الَّذِی لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهَذَا عَنِ اللَّهِ لَا عَنِّی وَ أَعَادَ ثَالِثاً فَقَامَ الْأَعْرَابِیُّ مُسْرِعاً إِلَی بَعِیرِهِ وَ هُوَ یَقُولُ اللهُمَّ إِنْ کانَ هذا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِکَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَیْنا حِجارَةً مِنَ السَّماءِ أَوِ ائْتِنا بِعَذابٍ أَلِیمٍ وَاقِعٍ قَالَ فَمَا اسْتَتَمَّ الْأَعْرَابِیُّ الْکَلِمَاتِ حَتَّی نَزَلَتْ عَلَیْهِ نَارٌ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَأَحْرَقَتْه.
32.fa: پیامبر (- ابوهُریره گوید: در روز غدیرخُم، جهاز شتران برای رسول خدا (روی هم قرار داده شد و پیامبر (بر فراز آن‌ها قرارگرفت و نخست حمد و سپاس پروردگار را به‌جا آورد؛ آنگاه بازوی امیرالمؤمنین علیّ‌بن‌ابی‌طالب (را گرفته و او را بلند نمود و فرمود: «خداوندا! هرکس من مولای اویم این علی (مولای اوست، خداوندا! دوستان او را دوست بدار و دشمنانش را دشمن بدار، یارانش را یاری کن و آن‌ها که ترک یاریش کنند، از یاری خویش محروم ساز». در این حال، عربی بیابان‌گرد از میان جمعیّت به‌سوی پیامبر (آمده و عرض کرد: «ای رسول خدا (! ما را خواندی که شهادت دهیم معبودی جز خدای یگانه نیست و تو فرستاده‌ی خدایی، ما نیز تصدیق نمودیم. به ما دستور نماز دادی، ما نیز نماز گزاردیم، دستور روزه دادی و ما روزه گرفتیم، دستور جهاد دادی و ما جهاد کردیم، دستور زکات دادی و ما زکات پرداخت کردیم، ولی این دستورات تو را قانع نساخت تا اینکه دست این نوجوان را در مقابل دیدگان همه گرفته و گفتی: «خداوندا! هرکس من مولای اویم علی (مولای اوست! آیا این‌کار از جانب خداست یا از جانب خودت»؟ پیامبر (فرمود: «این از جانب خداست نه جانب خودم». آن عرب گفت: «تو را به آن خدایی که معبودی جز او نیست قسم می‌دهم این از جانب خداست نه از جانب خودت»؟ پیامبر (فرمود: «قسم به آن خدایی که معبودی جز او نیست این از جانب خداست نه از جانب خودم» و این جمله را سه‌بار تکرار فرمود. عرب بیابان‌گرد با شنیدن این جمله با شتاب به‌سوی شترش حرکت کرد درحالی‌که می‌گفت: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ کانَ هذا هُوَ الحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِکَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَیْنا حِجارَةً مِنَ السَّماءِ أَوِ ائْتِنا بِعَذابٍ أَلِیمٍ. هنوز آن مرد عرب، این کلمات را به پایان نرسانده بود که آتشی از آسمان بر سرش فرود آمده و او را سوزاند.
32.en: Abu Hurayrah said: The camel saddles were piled up for the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) on the day of Ghadir Khumm. He ascended them, praised Allah the Exalted, and extolled Him. Then, he took the arm of the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), raised it, and said: "O Allah, whoever I am his master (mawla), this Ali (peace be upon him) is his master. O Allah, befriend whoever befriends him, be hostile to whoever is hostile to him, aid whoever aids him, and abandon whoever abandons him." Then, a Bedouin from among the common people stood up and said: "O Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), you called us to testify that there is no god but Allah and that you are the Messenger of Allah, and we believed. You commanded us to pray, and we prayed; to fast, and we fasted; to perform jihad, and we performed jihad; and to pay zakat, and we paid it. Yet, you were not satisfied until you took the hand of this young man before the witnesses and said: 'O Allah, whoever I am his master, Ali (peace be upon him) is his master.' Is this from Allah or from yourself?" He (peace be upon him and his family) replied: "This is from Allah, not from me." The man said: "By Allah, besides whom there is no god, is this from Allah, not from you?" He replied: "By Allah, besides whom there is no god, this is from Allah, not from me." He repeated this three times. The Bedouin then hurried toward his camel, saying: "O Allah, if this is the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful, imminent punishment." The narrator said: The Bedouin had not yet finished his words when a fire descended upon him from the sky and burned him.
32.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 5, p. 540
32.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 37, p. 173; Shawahid al-Tanzil, Vol. 2, p. 385 (with variations).

32.ar: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لَمَّا نَصَّ عَلَی عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) بِالْفَضِیلَةِ وَ الْإِمَامَةِ وَ سَکَنَ إِلَی ذَلِکَ قُلُوبُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ عَانَدَ فِیهِ أَصْنَافُ الْجَاحِدِینَ مِنَ الْمُعَانِدِینَ وَ شَکَّ فِی ذَلِکَ ضُعَفَاءُ مِنَ الشَّاکِّینَ وَ غَاضَ فِی صُدُورِ الْمُنَافِقِینَ الْعَدَاوَةُ وَ الْبَغْضَاءُ وَ الْحَسَدُ وَ الشَّحْنَاءُ حَتَّی قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِینَ لَقَدْ أَسْرَفَ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فِی مَدْحِ نَفْسِهِ ثُمَّ أَسْرَفَ فِی مَدْحِ أَخِیهِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) وَ مَا ذَلِکَ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِینَ وَ لَکِنَّهُ فِی ذَلِکَ مِنَ الْمَقْبُولِینَ یُرِیدُ أَنْ یُثْبِتَ لِنَفْسِهِ الرِّئَاسَةَ عَلَیْنَا وَ لِعَلِیٍّ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) قُلْ لَهُمْ وَ أَیَّ شَیْءٍ أَنْکَرْتُمْ مِنْ ذَلِکَ هُوَ عَظِیمٌ کَرِیمٌ حَکِیمٌ ارْتَضَی عِبَاداً مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَ اخْتَصَّهُمْ بِکَرَامَاتٍ لَمَّا عَلِمَ مِنْ حُسْنِ طَاعَتِهِمْ وَ انْقِیَادِهِمْ لِأَمْرِهِ فَفَوَّضَ إِلَیْهِمْ أُمُورَ عِبَادِهِ وَ جَعَلَ عَلَیْهِمْ سِیَاسَةَ خَلْقِهِ بِالتَّدْبِیرِ الْحَکِیمِ الَّذِی وَفَّقَهُمْ لَهُ أَوَ لَا تَرَوْنَ مُلُوکَ الْأَرْضِ إِذَا ارْتَضَی أَحَدُهُمْ خِدْمَةَ بَعْضِ عَبِیدِهِ وَ وَثِقَ بِحُسْنِ إِطَاعَتِهِ فِیمَا یَنْدُبُهُ لَهُ مِنْ أُمُورِ مَمَالِکِهِ جَعَلَ مَا وَرَاءَ بَابِهِ إِلَیْهِ وَ اعْتَمَدَ فِی سِیَاسَةِ جُیُوشِهِ وَ رَعَایَاهُ عَلَیْهِ کَذَلِکَ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فِی التَّدْبِیرِ الَّذِی رَفَعَهُ لَهُ رَبُّهُ وَ عَلِیٌّ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ الَّذِی جَعَلَهُ وَصِیَّهُ وَ خَلِیفَتَهُ فِی أَهْلِهِ وَ قَاضِیَ دَیْنِهِ وَ مُنْجِزَ عِدَاتِهِ وَ الْمُؤَازِرَ لِأَوْلِیَائِهِ وَ الْمُنَاصِبَ لِأَعْدَائِهِ فَلَمْ یَقْنَعُوا بِذَلِکَ وَ لَمْ یُسَلِّمُوا وَ قَالُوا لَیْسَ الَّذِی یُسْنِدُهُ إِلَی ابْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ بِأَمْرٍ صَغِیرٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ دِمَاءُ الْخَلْقِ وَ نِسَاؤُهُمْ وَ أَوْلَادُهُمْ وَ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَ حُقُوقُهُمْ وَ أَنْسَابُهُمْ وَ دُنْیَاهُمْ وَ آخِرَتُهُمْ فَلْیَأْتِنَا بِآیَةٍ یَلِیقُ بِجَلَالَةِ هَذِهِ الْوَلَایَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَمَا کَفَاکُمْ نُورُ عَلِیٍّ الْمُشْرِقُ فِی الظُّلُمَاتِ الَّذِی رَأَیْتُمُوهُ لَیْلَةَ خُرُوجِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِلَی مَنْزِلِهِ أَ مَا کَفَاکُمْ أَنَّ عَلِیّاً (علیه السلام) جَازَ وَ الْحِیطَانُ بَیْنَ یَدَیْهِ فَفُتِحَتْ لَهُ وَ طُرِقَتْ ثُمَّ عَادَتْ وَ الْتَأَمَتْ أَمَا کَفَاکُمْ یَوْمَ غَدِیرِ خُمٍّ أَنَّ عَلِیّاً لَمَّا أَقَامَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) رَأَیْتُمْ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ مُفَتَّحَةً وَ الْمَلَائِکَةَ مِنْهَا مُطَّلِعِینَ تُنَادِیکُمْ هَذَا وَلِیُّ اللَّهِ فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَ إِلَّا حَلَّ بِکُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ فَاحْذَرُوهُ أَمَا کَفَاکُمْ رُؤْیَتُکُمْ عَلِیَّ بْنَ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) وَ هُوَ یَمْشِی وَ الْجِبَالُ یَسِیرُ بَیْنَ یَدَیْهِ لِئَلَّا یَحْتَاجَ إِلَی الِانْحِرَافِ عَنْهَا فَلَمَّا جَازَ رَجَعَتِ الْجِبَالُ إِلَی أَمَاکِنِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ زِدْهُمْ آیَاتٍ فَإِنَّهَا عَلَیْکَ سَهْلَاتٌ یَسِیرَاتٌ لِتَزِیدَ حُجَّتُکَ عَلَیْهِمْ تَأْکِیداً قَالَ فَرَجَعَ الْقَوْمُ إِلَی بُیُوتِهِمْ فَأَرَادُوا دُخُولَهَا فَاعْتَقَلَتْهُمُ الْأَرْضُ وَ مَنَعَتْهُمْ وَ نَادَتْهُمْ حَرَامٌ عَلَیْکُمْ دُخُولُهَا حَتَّی تُؤْمِنُوا بِوَلَایَةِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) قَالُوا آمَنَّا وَ دَخَلُوا ثُمَّ ذَهَبُوا یَنْزِعُونَ ثِیَابَهُمْ لِیَلْبِسُوا غَیْرَهَا فَثَقُلَتْ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ لَمْ یُقِلُّوهَا وَ نَادَتْهُمْ حَرَامٌ عَلَیْکُمْ سُهُولَةُ نَزْعِهَا حَتَّی تُقِرُّوا بِوَلَایَةِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) فَأَقَرُّوا وَ نَزَعُوهَا ثُمَّ ذَهَبُوا لِیَلْبِسُوا ثِیَابَ اللَّیْلِ فَثَقُلَتْ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ نَادَتْهُمْ حَرَامٌ عَلَیْکُمْ لُبْسُنَا حَتَّی تَعْتَرِفُوا بِوَلَایَةِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) فَاعْتَرَفُوا فَذَهَبُوا یَأْکُلُونَ فَثَقُلَتْ عَلَیْهِمُ اللَّقْمُ وَ مَا لَمْ یَثْقُلْ مِنْهَا اسْتَحْجَرَ فِی أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَ نَادَتْهُمْ حَرَامٌ عَلَیْکُمْ أَکْلُنَا حَتَّی تَعْتَرِفُوا بِوَلَایَةِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) فَاعْتَرَفُوا ثُمَّ ذَهَبُوا یَبُولُونَ وَ یَتَغَوَّطُونَ فَتَعَذَّرَ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ نَادَتْهُمْ بُطُونُهُمْ وَ مَذَاکِیرُهُمْ حَرَامٌ عَلَیْکُمُ السَّلَامَةُ مِنَّا حَتَّی تَعْتَرِفُوا بِوَلَایَةِ عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) فَاعْتَرَفُوا ثُمَّ ضَجَرَ بَعْضُهُمْ وَ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ کانَ هذا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِکَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَیْنا حِجارَةً مِنَ السَّماءِ أَوِ ائْتِنا بِعَذابٍ أَلِیم قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی وَ ما کانَ اللهُ لِیُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ أَنْتَ فِیهِمْ فَإِنَّ عَذَابَ الِاصْطِلَامِ الْعَامِّ إِذَا نَزَلَ نَزَلَ بَعْدَ خُرُوجِ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) مِنْ بَیْنِ أَظْهُرِهِمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ ما کانَ اللهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ هُمْ یَسْتَغْفِرُونَ یُظْهِرُونَ التَّوْبَةَ وَ الْإِنَابَةَ فَإِنَّ مِنْ حُکْمِهِ فِی الدُّنْیَا أَنْ یَأْمُرَکَ بِقَبُولِ الظَّاهِرِ وَ تَرْکِ التَّفْتِیشِ عَنِ الْبَاطِنِ لِأَنَّ الدُّنْیَا دَارُ إمْهَاٍل وَ إِنْظَارٍ وَ الْآخِرَةَ دَارُ الْجَزَاءِ بِلَاتَعَبُّدٍ قَالَ وَما کانَ اللهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَ فِیهِمْ مَنْ یَسْتَغْفِرُ لِأَنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَوْ لَا أَنَّ فِیهِمْ مَنْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ سَیُؤْمِنُ أَوْ أَنَّهُ سَیَخْرُجُ مِنْ نَسْلِهِ ذُرِّیَّةٌ طَیِّبَةٌ یَجُودُ رَبُّکَ عَلَی هَؤُلَاءِ بِالْإِیمَانِ وَ ثَوَابِهِ وَ لَا یَقْتَطِعُهُمْ بِاخْتِرَامِ آبَائِهِمُ الْکُفَّارِ وَ لَوْ لَا ذَلِکَ لَأَهْلَکَهُمْ فَذَلِکَ قَوْلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) کَذَلِکَ اقْتَرَحَ النَّاصِبُونَ آیَاتٍ فِی عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) حَتَّی اقْتَرَحُوا مَا لَایَجُوزُ فِی حِکْمَتِهِ جَهْلًا بِأَحْکَامِ اللَّهِ وَ اقْتِرَاحاً لِلْأَبَاطِیلِ عَلَی اللَّهِ.
32.en:
When the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) explicitly designated Ali (peace be upon him) with excellence and Imamate, the hearts of the believers found peace in it. However, various types of deniers and obstinate people opposed it, the weak among the doubters felt uncertainty, and enmity, hatred, envy, and malice grew in the chests of the hypocrites. One of the hypocrites even said, "Muhammad (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) has gone to excess in praising himself, and then he has gone to excess in praising his brother Ali (peace be upon him). This is not from the Lord of the Worlds; rather, he is among those who are accepted [by the people], and he wants to establish leadership for himself over us, and for Ali after his death."

Allah the Almighty said: "O Muhammad, say to them: 'And what is it that you deny of this? He is Great, Generous, and Wise. He chose some of His servants and distinguished them with honors when He knew of the excellence of their obedience and their submission to His command. Thus, He entrusted the affairs of His servants to them and placed the governance of His creation upon them through the wise management for which He granted them success. Do you not see the kings of the earth? When one of them chooses some of his servants for service and trusts in the excellence of his obedience in the matters of his kingdom that he delegates to him, he places what is beyond his own door under his authority and relies upon him for the governance of his armies and subjects. Likewise is Muhammad (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) in the management that his Lord has elevated for him, and Ali (peace be upon him) after him, whom He made his successor and caliph among his family, the fulfiller of his debts, the executor of his promises, the supporter of his allies, and the adversary of his enemies.'"

They were not satisfied with this, nor did they submit. They said, "What he attributes to the son of Abu Talib is no small matter; it concerns the blood of the people, their women, their children, their wealth, their rights, their lineages, their worldly lives, and their hereafter. So let him bring us a sign that befits the majesty of this Wilayah."

The Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) said, "Is the light of Ali, which shines in the darkness—which you saw on the night he left the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) for his house—not enough for you? Is it not enough for you that Ali (peace be upon him) passed by while the walls were before him, and they opened for him and made a path, then returned and joined together? Is it not enough for you that on the day of Ghadir Khumm, when the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) raised Ali, you saw the gates of heaven opened and the angels looking down from them, calling out to you: 'This is the Wali of Allah, so follow him, or else the punishment of Allah will befall you, so beware of it'? Is it not enough for you to have seen Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) walking while the mountains moved before him so that he would not need to deviate from them, and when he passed, the mountains returned to their places?"

Then he said, "O Allah, increase them in signs, for they are easy and simple for You, so that Your proof against them may be confirmed."

It is said that the people returned to their homes and wanted to enter them, but the earth seized them and prevented them, calling out to them, "It is forbidden for you to enter until you believe in the Wilayah of Ali (peace be upon him)." They said, "We believe," and entered. Then they went to remove their clothes to put on others, but the clothes became heavy upon them and they could not remove them. The clothes called out to them, "It is forbidden for you to easily remove us until you acknowledge the Wilayah of Ali (peace be upon him)." So they acknowledged it and removed them. Then they went to put on their night clothes, but they became heavy upon them, and the clothes called out to them, "It is forbidden for you to wear us until you acknowledge the Wilayah of Ali (peace be upon him)." So they acknowledged it. Then they went to eat, but the morsels became heavy upon them, and those that were not heavy turned to stone in their mouths, and the food called out to them, "It is forbidden for you to eat us until you acknowledge the Wilayah of Ali (peace be upon him)." So they acknowledged it. Then they went to urinate and defecate, but it became difficult for them, and their stomachs and private parts called out to them, "It is forbidden for you to have relief from us until you acknowledge the Wilayah of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him)." So they acknowledged it.

Finally, some of them became frustrated and said, "O Allah, if this is the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment." Allah the Almighty said: "But Allah would not punish them while you are among them" (Anfal/33), for the general destructive punishment, when it descends, descends after the Prophet (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) has departed from among them. Then Allah the Almighty said: "And Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness," by showing repentance and turning back to God. For it is among His laws in this world that He commands you to accept the outward appearance and refrain from investigating the inward, because the world is a place of respite and delay, while the Hereafter is the place of recompense without obligation.

He said: "And Allah would not punish them while there is among them one who seeks forgiveness," because if it were not for the fact that among them are those whom Allah knows will believe, or that from their offspring will come a pure progeny, your Lord would not bestow upon them faith and its reward, and He does not cut them off by destroying their disbelieving fathers. Were it not for that, He would have destroyed them. This is the meaning of the words of the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family): "Thus did the Nasibis (enemies) demand signs regarding Ali (peace be upon him) until they demanded what is not permissible in His wisdom, out of ignorance of the laws of Allah and out of demanding falsehoods from Allah."
